environment: Node + jsdom, service-worker Cache API model, and node-web-audio-api real OfflineAudioContext/custom AudioWorklets; NOT Safari or Chromium

tests.name: 7: PCM LRU respects 32 MiB, pinned buffers and keep-alive imports
7: Stop releases PCM leases even if a closed context rejects gain automation
7: concurrent decode reservations prevent oversubscription and pending cache retries recover
7: long user file is rejected from metadata before arrayBuffer/decode
7: synthesis is lazy, cooperative fallback bounded and finite
7: offline scalar calibration cache deduplicates and serialises renders
7: cooperative RMS fallback uses the identical custom gain computer and detector
8: audio resume handles suspended/interrupted, timeout, late state and no autoplay
8: global Stop also invalidates a pending Sunny audition, so resume cannot start stale audio
8: unsupported offline worklets do not mark a working realtime engine as native fallback
8: offline install is atomic; cached shell, 12 samples, ranges and scoped cleanup work offline
8: precache covers every runtime asset, worker dependency and local manifest icon
9: seeded adaptive sampling favours weak bands but retains exploration; other skills use misses
11: daily goals, duplicate protection, spaced intervals, Toronto midnight/DST and rest days
10: keyboard tabs, hidden panels, numeric alternatives, rotary End and reduced motion
10: selected foreground/background contrast pairs exceed WCAG AA normal text
12: v1.6 backups migrate; v1.7 learning state exports/restores/resets; unsafe review targets rejected
12: DSP optimisation preserves golden samples from v1.6 exactly
12: real OfflineAudioContext renders custom matched EQ at 44.1/48 kHz across 20 Hz–20 kHz
12: real OfflineAudioContext compressor static curve and rough attack/release timing

limits: No real iPhone/Android CPU/RAM or Safari interruption test
Service-worker tests use a standards-shaped Cache API model, not an installed browser PWA
